messages.subject: Re: resource org/renjin/stats/environment not found?
parts:
There's been a change to the way packages are serialized, (large objects are now stored seperately) it's meant to be backwards with the previous impl, but perhaps something went wrong with the merge?

See https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/commit/9a53834c266fbeaf71a19861562c921dbbbd52b8

Hth,
Alex

On Dec 27, 2013 8:59 AM, "Hao" <hlin...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi folks,

I have been working with Renjin application and it works fine for me. However, after I have merged with master branch, it turns out a runtime exception:

 java.lang.RuntimeException: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: resource org/renjin/stats/environment not found.
        at org.renjin.eval.SessionBuilder.build(SessionBuilder.java:77)

When I checked my application jar file, the org/renjin/stats/environment exists. 

Anyone has some clue about this?

Thanks a lot,

Hao
